video.description: Video to extend. 1.625s to 60s, up to 50 MB, aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5.
video.title: Video

prompt.description: What happens next. Describe the continuation, not the source.
examples: The camera keeps pushing forward as the fog lifts and a lighthouse appears on the cliff.
prompt.title: Prompt

duration.description: Seconds of new footage to add (1-15).
duration.title: Duration

output.description: extended: source plus new footage as one video. continuation: only the new clip, with a 1.625s repeat of the source ending.
output.title: Output

aspect_ratio.description: auto follows the source; other values crop to fit.

reference_audios.description: Audio references guiding the new audio (2-15s each, 15s combined). The source soundtrack is kept.
reference_audios.title: Reference Audios

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Enhance the prompt using the source video for a consistent continuation.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
